expires_tomorrow.title: Image in the '20s: A Megabundle by Image Comics
expires_tomorrow.long_description: The decade may only be half over, but the 2020s have been good to Image Comics, one of the most exciting publishers of the day that is consistently putting out great stuff. To celebrate Image’s recent successes, we’ve put together a megabundle of their best series, so that longtime fans and new readers can find their new favorite stories! This bundle includes collected volumes of tech dystopian superhero story The Dead Lucky, rural Canadian horror series Fishflies, intergalactic warrior drama Free Agents, geriatric battle royale action series Golden Rage, child vampire saga Little Monsters, and more! If those sound good to you, just wait to see what else is in store in this giant—and we mean giant—bundle of Image’s best new comics! Grab them now at the price of your choice, and support BINC with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Self-Reliance and Off-Grid Skills for Dummies
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Don’t just survive in the modern outdoors—thrive. Our newest For Dummies bundle features some of the hottest and most useful ebooks for individuals looking to have fun in the wild or start a craft career. Get amazing titles like Solar Power Your Home For Dummies, 2e, Vegetable Gardening For Dummies, 3e, How to Fix Everything For Dummies, and Ham Radio For Dummies, 4e. Plus, your purchase helps support Covenant House.

expires_tomorrow.title: Industrial Lands
expires_tomorrow.description: 600+ assets to create massive industrial worlds
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Create sprawling factories, diesel-powered districts, heavy construction sites, and mechanized battlefields with the Industrial Lands Bundle by KitBash3D. Packed with industrial environments, bold architecture, armored structures, construction machinery, and powerful mechs, this collection is made for developing worlds with weight, scale, and grit. Build everything from hard-working cityscapes to dystopian strongholds and sci-fi warzones with production-ready assets designed to drop into your workflow. Compatible with Blender, Unreal, and more—these Hollywood-quality assets are ready to elevate your next project to new heights. Plus, your purchase helps support Make-A-Wish!

Keys expire. Please redeem before October 28th, 2026.

expires_tomorrow.title: Embedded Firmware Developer Toolkit by Packt
expires_tomorrow.description: Build, Program, and Master the Brains behind Modern Devices
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Take control of the hardware that powers the modern world with this hands-on embedded systems toolkit from Packt! Dive deep into microcontrollers, ARM Cortex-M development, RTOS, and embedded Linux as you build the skills needed to design, program, and optimize real-world devices. Whether you're an aspiring firmware engineer or an experienced developer expanding into embedded systems, this bundle equips you to write efficient code, manage hardware, and bring intelligent devices to life, while supporting charity with your purchase.

expires_tomorrow.title: Freedom to Create with COREL Graphics Suite 2025
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Feel like your graphic design projects could use a little more pizzazz? Take your art to the next level with the 2025 edition of CorelDRAW Graphics Suite—professional quality graphic design software with all the bells and whistles. Plus, catch up with classic heroes and heroines like John Carter and Red Sonja! All of this and more is included in this megabundle of mini-adventures, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support the Comic Book Legal Defense Fund with your purchase!
